user.title: Pentair IntelliFlo VS+SVRS
user.description: A Pentair IntelliFlo behind a Waveshare RS-485 gateway. On first connect the integration takes over whatever the pump is doing; after that its power switch and speed slider set what the pump does.

data_description.svrs_restart: On: after an SVRS trip the pump restarts itself once its 30 s restart timer runs out. Off: it stays stopped.

abort.already_configured: This gateway is already set up.

data_description.svrs_restart: On: after an SVRS trip the pump restarts itself once its 30 s restart timer runs out. Off: it stays stopped. Written to the pump the next time it is stopped.
